semiconductor_relevance: High — Zhonghuan Advanced specializes in the R&D and manufacturing of semiconductor materials, particularly EPI wafers, polished wafers, SOI, and SiC.
summary: Zhonghuan Advanced Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research and development as well as manufacturing of semiconductor materials and products. They provide comprehensive solutions for industries such as IC, automotive electronics, and AI, aiming to be a leading global supplier in the semiconductor materials sector.
